title: LILAC: An Idempotent Neural Speech Codec
abstract: arXiv:2608.05727v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural Audio Codecs are widely adopted in speech generation and editing. However, existing neural audio codecs are not idempotent: across the paper's twelve baseline systems, every configuration tested rewrites, on average, at least 15% of its tokens in a single decode-re-encode pass. This poses a problem for utilizing Neural Audio Codecs as token interfaces in pipelines where re-encoding decoded outputs can occur. We present LILAC, a fully convolutional 24 kHz speech codec at 9.375 Hz and 0.75 kbit/s that is codec idempotent by construction; re-encoding the decoded audio of any valid token stream returns the identical stream. LILAC achieves idempotency while maintaining competitive quality, reaching UTMOS 4.14 and 4.24 on LibriSpeech and LibriTTS-R test sets, comparable to SOTA sub-1 kbit/s Neural Audio Codecs.

translated_title: LILAC：一种幂等的神经语音编解码器
translated_abstract: 神经音频编解码器在语音生成和编辑中被广泛采用。然而，现有的神经音频编解码器并不具备幂等性：在论文的十二个基线系统中，每个测试配置在单次解码-再编码过程中平均至少重写其15%的令牌。这在利用神经音频编解码器作为管道中的令牌接口时构成了问题，因为在这些管道中可能发生对解码输出的重新编码。我们提出了LILAC，一种全卷积的24 kHz语音编解码器，运行在9.375 Hz和0.75 kbit/s，其构造上具有编解码器幂等性；对任何有效令牌流的解码音频进行重新编码会返回相同的令牌流。LILAC在保持竞争性质量的同时实现了幂等性，在LibriSpeech和LibriTTS-R测试集上分别达到UTMOS 4.14和4.24，与最先进的低于1 kbit/s神经音频编解码器相当。
tldr: LILAC通过构造实现完全幂等的神经语音编解码器，在极低比特率下保持高质量，解决了现有编解码器在重新编码时令牌失真的问题。
en_tdlr: LILAC achieves fully idempotent neural speech coding by construction, maintaining high quality at ultra-low bitrates, addressing the token distortion issue in re-encoding pipelines.
